subject: How to use df from upload file widget?

messages.author: 3074773d3b9402c0
messages.subject: How to use df from upload file widget?
parts:
Hi, I want to plot a bar chart using a csv file on my desktop. 

If I call the data with "read.csv", and keep the df in memory my plots get executed. However, I don't know how to use the same data from the upload file widget.

I've followed this example: http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/upload-file.html and was able to plot a data table. 

But how can I plot a barchart using the data frame uploaded? How do I access it?


## server.R ###

output$contents <- renderTable({
         
              
              inFile <- input$file1
              
              if (is.null(inFile))
                return(NULL)
              
              read.csv(inFile$datapath, header = input$header,
                       sep = input$sep, quote = input$quote)
            
              })


This is how I do plot a data table. But how to access the new df to use it in another graphics?



I've tried this (but got: object 'inFile' not found) :

                       sep = input$sep, quote = input$quote)
            
              })
